reviews.comment: He is honestly one of the best professors in the department. His lectures are fast-paced, but he uses visuals that help alot. You will need to do all of his homework because it is very similar to the exams. Office hours are extremely helpful, though. Just lock in, and ask for help instead of complaining about it being hard. He's the goat.

Homework is worth nothing in this class. The class is hard, but office hours are very helpful and highly recommended to complete assignments. He does not post any lecture notes, so attending is essential and gives occasional bonuses.

Rockey was a fantastic professor. His lectures, while fast-paced, were very helpful for the weekly homework and the 3 exams. While attendance isn't mandatory, he does not post notes. He also gave out a bunch of extra credit (almost a whole letter grade) towards the end of the year. If you go to his office hours and apply yourself, you will succeed.

If you truly apply yourself, you will do fine in this class. His homework is hard and very time consuming but you are well prepared for tests after you complete them. Go to office hours early on so you make sure you are learning concepts fully, he is very helpful! Be prepared to write a lot. He does not post notes and he will go fast in lecture.

He is a very good professor who teaches well but can go fast on occasion. He kind of expects at least foundational knowledge and at the point of taking the course you should understand what he talks about. As long as you go to class and actually do the homework by yourself, (just spend time actually learning!!) you will be completely fine.

80% of the course is exams, including a 40% final. However, he does grade the exams very nicely and as long as you try, and he sees that, you will do good. Main recommendation is to really try on the homework as the exams usually contain similar questions. Overall, I enjoyed the way his lectures tied into the real world.

Rockey is a nice professor but he's not always clear about explaining things in lecture. He doesn't always post notes from class. The homeworks are about once a week but are very long and difficult. You'll need to go to office hours and ask questions in lecture to understand the material and do well on exams. Exams are 80% of class grade.
First off, he is helpful and very nice in office hours/outside of class. But his lectures are so bad. I had him for 345 and 363 and it was such a terrible experience both times. Do not reccomend
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Do not take 345 with Rockey. If you want the most stressful semester go ahead. Homework is extremely difficult and does not give the homework answers till right before exams. Little resources considering the difficulty of this class. Exams can be graded harshly and a large majority of the class q dropped.
Awful professor, lecture notes are not helpful for exams or hw. He does not post hw solutions or previous exam solutions. Class averages are usually below passing but he does not care.

You can't really skip class and you've gotta be quick with taking notes because he doesn't post them. The class is a hard subject overall, but he goes through lots of problems in class. He's super helpful in office hours. The homework takes forever and he expects you to know statics (221) and mechanics (305) really well. Grades are 90% exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Do not take him. Class is 90% tests (2 midterms 25% each and final is 40%). He gives 0 feedback on anything and doesn't post any solutions. He does post 30 practice tests but doesn't post the solutions to these either so you don't know if you're doing it right. Lectures are entirely on blank paper and aren't posted either. Messes up every lecture.
Do not take this professor. He writes very fast and his lectures are not helpful for homework or exams. His homework and exams are very tough as he uses graduate level problems.

He doesn't post notes and only writes on blank paper, but he's gotten better since he got here. It's a difficult course, but if you got to class, you will pass. He grades leniently on exams and provides a bonus assignment. Go to office hours!!!! He doesn't give much feedback on hw or exams, but it you go to office hours, he's super helpful.

Dr. Rockey is a great person but a not a good professor. His class is 90% exams, and his lectures are not helpful. He assigns way too much homework. The key to doing well in his class is to advocate for yourself. He's always available to answer your questions and help you outside of class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Rockey is overhated. There are definitely easier professors to take but you can get a good grade in his class. I think a big issue is that he expects your level of knowledge about the subjects to be unreasonably high. He added material that was not in the textbook and was taken from grad level courses for some reason.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very tough class but also the first time I felt like I learned anything. He is very understanding so you just have to advocate for yourself a lot in this class. Most people don't like him because his lectures can be a bit confusing and he assigns a lot of homework. The best thing to do for this class is just to constantly go to office hours.

This guy is new so I don't want to be too harsh, but come on man. His notes are NOT helpful, he is monotone, and how much work he assigns not only exceeds what is necessary, but it doesn't help anyone know the material better. My advice: Regardless of professor, take ECEN 215 or BAEN 320 instead. From what I've heard, they are both way easier.
